regulatory_standard: ICH Q9(R1) Quality Risk Management — Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

failure_modes.failure_mode: Unattended weekend sequence pause (>24h) + Sample Manager Peltier chiller drift (>15°C) causing on-tray Asn deamidation artifact
failure_modes.effect_of_failure: False OOS on Acidic Peak Group; potential PPQ/BLA batch delay or improper Phase I re-testing risk
failure_modes.capa_mitigation: Empower Max Sequence Timeout hard-coded at 24h; automated LIMS IoT alert on Sample Manager >8.0°C or >250 bar backpressure; mandatory preventive in-line filter swap every 80 injections.

failure_modes.process_area: Analytical Tech Transfer (HPLC to UPLC Gradient Methods)
failure_modes.failure_mode: Uncompensated system dwell volume deficit (ΔV_D = -0.83 mL) shifting CEX/RP retention times and compressing pre-peak resolution
failure_modes.effect_of_failure: Co-validation failure; delayed Example CDMO Client partner timeline and repeat method bridging executions
failure_modes.capa_mitigation: Mandatory LSS/SMA mechanistic dwell-volume calculator execution in Modular ATTP Module MOD-02 prior to bench execution.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Evaporative edge effect in outer 36 perimeter wells (Rows A/H, Cols 1/12) during 37°C incubation distorting 4-PL Hill slope
failure_modes.effect_of_failure: High assay invalidation rate (>18%) due to USP <1034> parallelism gate failures; W42 Bioassay skid bottleneck
failure_modes.capa_mitigation: Standardized Hamilton STAR liquid handler script to Inner-60 Well layout with 200 µL sterile PBS moat in Outer-36 perimeter wells.

failure_modes.process_area: Dual-Stream QC Capacity Scheduling (W42 Wave Loading)
failure_modes.failure_mode: Simultaneous arrival of zero-float PPQ/BLA release lots and routine ICH Q1A stability pulls exceeding 100% UPLC skid capacity
failure_modes.effect_of_failure: Analyst overtime burnout, elevated human bench error rate, and CDMO QTA turnaround SLA breach risk
failure_modes.capa_mitigation: Automated weekly Heijunka capacity leveling shifting routine 6M/9M/12M stability pulls within site-defined pull windows (example ±7 d).

failure_modes.process_area: DSP Protein A Elution & Low-pH Viral Inactivation (Phase II Interface)
failure_modes.failure_mode: pH probe calibration drift during pH 3.5 viral inactivation hold causing local pH 3.2 exposure and soluble dimer/oligomer nucleation
failure_modes.effect_of_failure: True batch OOS on SEC-UPLC HMW% (>2.0%) or delayed 6M 25°C OOT stability aggregation inflection
failure_modes.capa_mitigation: Dual redundant optical/glass pH probes on DSP viral inactivation skid + Hybrid Eyring+ANN-TVP early OOT stability screening at 3M/6M.
